description: The plot illustrates how validation BPC changes over training for two methods, with two lines labeled “SMoE Validating” and “SimSMoE Validating.” The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 50 with major ticks at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50, and an annotation “(x10^3)” indicating the steps are in thousands. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 1.2 to 2.2 with labeled ticks at 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2.0, and 2.2. The “SMoE Validating” series is drawn as a black solid line with x-shaped markers; it starts near 2.15 at 0k steps, drops steeply to about 1.70 at 1k and ~1.45 by around 3k, then declines more gradually to roughly 1.30 by about 10k and ~1.22 by about 20k, after which it stays nearly flat with small fluctuations around ~1.18–1.20 through 50k. The “SimSMoE Validating” series is drawn as a magenta solid line with circular markers; it also begins near 2.15 at 0k, falls to about 1.70 at 1k and ~1.45 by around 3k, decreases to roughly 1.29–1.30 by about 10k and ~1.21 by about 20k, and then remains close to ~1.17–1.19 with minor oscillations through 50k, ending slightly below the black series near the right edge.
